raidSayLines.line: A man, maybe 30s, with restless hands: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The raccoon with too many fingers stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.

💬 Raul pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
A kite over the treeline. Nobody is holding the string. On its screen, for a frame: you, from above.

📓 Codex: Ben of Stonebridge raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Ben of Stonebridge didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 1,000 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Sofia Hassan. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
